"""Centralized constants for the entity-placement page.

Per this package's CLAUDE.md, the item roles, category keys, dialog sizes,
vector ranges and formatting parameters used across the entity-placement
mixins are collected here so magic numbers are not scattered through the
implementation modules.

This module is intentionally dependency-free (no Qt import) so the values can
be reused and unit-tested in isolation. Item-role values follow Qt's
convention of offsetting from ``Qt.UserRole`` (256); consumers may pass these
integers directly to ``QListWidgetItem.setData`` / ``data``.
"""

# --- Item roles -------------------------------------------------------------
# Offsets from Qt.UserRole (256). Kept as plain ints to avoid a Qt import here.
_USER_ROLE = 256

ROLE_RESOURCE_ID = _USER_ROLE + 0
ROLE_CATEGORY = _USER_ROLE + 1
ROLE_IS_SHARED = _USER_ROLE + 2
ROLE_LEVEL_ENTITY = _USER_ROLE + 3

# --- Category keys ----------------------------------------------------------
CATEGORY_ENTITY = "entity"
CATEGORY_DECORATION = "decoration"
CATEGORY_LEVEL_ENTITY = "level_entity"

CATEGORY_KEYS = (
    CATEGORY_ENTITY,
    CATEGORY_DECORATION,
    CATEGORY_LEVEL_ENTITY,
)

# --- Dialog sizes -----------------------------------------------------------
# (width, height) in logical pixels.
DIALOG_DEFAULT_SIZE = (480, 360)
DIALOG_MERGE_DECORATIONS_SIZE = (640, 480)

# --- Vector ranges ----------------------------------------------------------
# Inclusive (min, max) bounds for placement vector components.
VECTOR_MIN = -100000.0
VECTOR_MAX = 100000.0
VECTOR_RANGE = (VECTOR_MIN, VECTOR_MAX)

# --- Formatting parameters --------------------------------------------------
# Decimal places used when rendering vector components into the list badges.
VECTOR_DECIMALS = 3
VECTOR_FORMAT = "{{:.{}f}}".format(VECTOR_DECIMALS)

"""Unit tests for the centralized entity-placement constants.

These verify that the anchor ``constants.py`` collects the categories called
out in CLAUDE.md (item roles, category keys, dialog sizes, vector ranges,
formatting parameters) and keeps them internally consistent.
"""

import importlib

constants = importlib.import_module(
    "app.ui.graph.library_pages.entity_placement.constants"
)


def test_item_roles_are_distinct_user_role_offsets():
    roles = [
        constants.ROLE_RESOURCE_ID,
        constants.ROLE_CATEGORY,
        constants.ROLE_IS_SHARED,
        constants.ROLE_LEVEL_ENTITY,
    ]
    assert all(role >= 256 for role in roles)
    assert len(set(roles)) == len(roles)


def test_category_keys_match_tuple():
    assert constants.CATEGORY_KEYS == (
        constants.CATEGORY_ENTITY,
        constants.CATEGORY_DECORATION,
        constants.CATEGORY_LEVEL_ENTITY,
    )
    assert len(set(constants.CATEGORY_KEYS)) == len(constants.CATEGORY_KEYS)


def test_dialog_sizes_are_positive_pairs():
    for size in (
        constants.DIALOG_DEFAULT_SIZE,
        constants.DIALOG_MERGE_DECORATIONS_SIZE,
    ):
        width, height = size
        assert width > 0 and height > 0


def test_vector_range_is_ordered_and_consistent():
    assert constants.VECTOR_RANGE == (constants.VECTOR_MIN, constants.VECTOR_MAX)
    assert constants.VECTOR_MIN < constants.VECTOR_MAX


def test_vector_format_uses_configured_decimals():
    assert constants.VECTOR_DECIMALS >= 0
    rendered = constants.VECTOR_FORMAT.format(1.23456)
    assert rendered == "1.235"
